verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no general automation capability, such as scheduled experiments, recurring jobs, or user-defined triggered workflows that run unattended. The closest feature is log alerts, which evaluate a metric against a threshold over a time window and notify users. That is a related monitoring feature, not an automation that acts autonomously in the background, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
